legacyPointAssessment.knownFact: The old coordinate is the current bundled reference,1.547km south of the uniquely named village node. Prior source-coordinate review had only the near-northern OSM/GeoNames candidates and did not identify a separate named settlement at the old coordinate.
legacyPointAssessment.limits: Lack of a source citation is not proof the old coordinate was fraudulent or outside all municipal land. No full town boundary is invented, and no certificate of original INM station coordinates was found.
